articleTitle: Gravitational Search Algorithm With Hierarchical Structure Guided By Elite Individual
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The Gravitational Search Algorithm (GSA) is a Newtonian gravity-based meta-heuristic algorithm. The algorithm updates population members’ locations according to the gravitational pull between them in order to solve the optimization issue. However, in some cases, the convergence of the algorithm is not fast enough. In order to improve the convergence speed of the algorithm while alleviating the problem of easily falling into local optima, we propose a gravitational search algorithm with hierarchical structure (EHGSA) guided by elite individuals. This structure can help the algorithm to have the ability to jump out of the local optimum while improving the convergence speed. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm EHGSA is validated using the IEEE CEC2017 benchmark function test set of 29 functions.

articleTitle: Melting Your Models: An Integrated AI-based Creativity Support Tool for Inspiration Evolution
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Design is a creative, complex, and iterative process. Although a variety of AI models for supporting design has been developed, there is little research on providing a seamless flow across multiple AI models, as well as the inspiration evolution within the process. We present an integrated AI-based Creativity Support Tool(AI-CST) that systematically integrates multiple AI models and contains a novel Inpiration Evolver to facilitate collaboration between designers and AI models. A between-subject sneaker-design experiment comparing our integrated AI-CST and non-integrated AI-CST shows that our AI-CST can significantly improve designers’ performance. Different using preferences and evolution styles have been discovered by the Inspiration Evolver, which inspires further study on the adaptation of the integrated AI-CST.

articleTitle: Physical design for driven device of Z-FFR based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Z-FFR (Z-Pinch driven fusion fission hybrid reactor) is composed of a Z-Pinch driven device, a fusion physics target chamber and a sub-critical reactor, the physical designed of the driving device is a key and central step, which plays a leading role in the engineering of the entire device system. There will be millions of capacitors, inductors, resistors, etc. in the circuitry, and the model parameters will be obtained through machine learning, so that the final parameters can be optimally accurate on the training set with minimal loss, and this approach is geared towards the learning outcome. With this initialisation parameter, only a small number of learning samples are needed to rapidly converge in the model in the face of similar scenarios of non-linear non-constant physics problems, thus improving the generalisation capability with few samples and balancing accuracy and learning efficiency. driven fusion fission hybrid reactor modeling is of great significance.

articleTitle: An Evolution Algorithm Based on Cloud Model for 0-1 Knapsack Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The 0-1 knapsack problem is a well-known NP hard problem in the field of combinatorial optimization. Some approximation algorithms are easy to get into local optimization. When the greedy algorithm is used to solve the problem, it always makes the best choice in the current view, not considering the overall optimization, and finally gets a certain approximate solution. Based on the greedy idea, a novel evolutionary algorithm is proposed, considering the use of cloud model, a cognitive computing model, to randomly select each step. The novel algorithm uses cloud model to express the fuzzy concept of "the highest cost performance". According to the preferential selection strategy of greedy idea and the randomness of cloud model, the initial solution population can be generated, and then the optimal solution can be searched through the mutation operation and the elite protection mechanism to update the population. Two examples are selected for experiments, and the results compared with relevant literatures show that the new algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: SOC evaluation of lithium batteries based on VKF, ampere-hour integration and unsteady open circuit voltage fusion method
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Since the temperature, actual current, aging degree and other factors cause certain errors in the measurement of battery parameters, which affects the calculation based on the VKF algorithm and affects the measurement accuracy of the battery SOC, a time-lapse integration method and unsteady Simulation and experimental results show that the initial value of SOC can be preliminarily and accurately measured by the unsteady open-circuit voltage method, and then the initial value of SOC can be corrected by Using Kalman Filtering Algorithm, and finally the corresponding power compensation relationship is established by using the ampere integration method, the correction method is studied, the impact of current measurement error on SOC estimation is reduced, and the calibration frequency of the Ampere method The correction method is studied, the impact of current measurement error on SOC estimation is reduced, and the calibration frequency of the Ampere method can be reduced, which can effectively solve the problems of inaccurate SOC estimation and cumulative error of initial value, and finally control the SOC The SOC estimation value within the high precision range.

articleTitle: DQN-based online scheduling algorithm for hybrid flow shop to minimize the total tardiness
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the hybrid flow shop scheduling problem with dynamic order arrival, a Deep-Q-Network(DQN) online scheduling method based on scheduling rules is proposed. In order to cope with the continuous production state and learn the most appropriate actions at each scheduling point, with the goal of minimizing the total tardiness, combined with classical scheduling rules, it is used to select jobs and assign them to feasible machines when each job is completed or a new job arrives, and extract 7 state features to represent the production state of the scheduling point. Numerical experiments are carried out on a large number of different production configurations. Experimental results show that DQN has advantages and versatility compared with single scheduling rules and Q-learning.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Fault Diagnosis Based on CNN-GRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The environment in which transmission lines are located is complex and harsh, and various types of faults are prone to occur. In order to prevent the further expansion of the scope of accidents caused by transmission line faults, this paper proposes a transmission line fault diagnosis method combining Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU). Firstly, a fault diagnosis model of transmission line based on CNN-GRU is established to train and test the collected data; then, a simulation test system of transmission line is established, the parameters of the system and line are designed, and the transmission line is proposed. Finally, accurate fault diagnosis is carried out by simulating the test system and the diagnostic model. The experimental results show that the accuracy of fault diagnosis using this method is very high, and it can guide the daily operation and maintenance of actual transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research on AR-UGC Product Innovation Design for Future Community Digital Display Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Location-Based AR(Augmented Reality) experiences have increasingly appeared in a variety of products in recent years, and many studies have provided initial evidence of the effectiveness of this form of interaction in facilitating user experience and social communication User-generated content (UGC) is a user-centred method of developing and managing online knowledge bases, which includes significant social characteristics. Although few studies have thoroughly examined this mode of engagement, the usage of AR technology for UGC offers enormous potential to improve user experience and social ties among users. This study combines AR with UGC to create an augmented reality multiplayer real-time interactive application for usage in the community, promoting communication among residents, fostering close neighbourhood ties and shared values enhancing residents’ lives. The main function of the product is to use props to individually or collaboratively produce UGC in order to "transform" the community area in a personalized way. The product also has a complete asset system and friend system to promote a balanced and social experience.

articleTitle: A Novel Differential Evolution Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, a method of improvement with sparrow search algorithm is proposed, namely differential sparrow search algorithm (DSSA). It is inspired by some advanced differential evolution algorithms and sparrow search algorithm. In DSSA, we proposed an operation of differential evolution to improve the ability to search locally. Several results show that the comprehensive performance of DSSA is improved compared with SSA and is better than some classical algorithms.

articleTitle: Exploration of Emotions Developed in the lnteraction with Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Innovations in the last decade have demonstrated Artificial Intelligence’s remarkable capabilities to augment humans in intensive cognitive tasks. Unfortunately, these recognized advancements do not correspondingly translate to increased trust or reliance, given the significant concern on its black-box structure. This paradox led to the recent rise of Explainable Al (XAI), which aims to provide human-level translation of Al’s complex inner workings, commonly via visual cues. Being relatively new, the focus has been on improving and developing new techniques to provide deeper explanations. However, its effectiveness may not entirely depend on the cognitive resource it provides. As social science and human-computer interaction research suggest, emotions developed from the interaction can affect decisions. To explore the viability of this theory in the context of XAI, preliminary research was done to determine whether a specific emotion set can be engendered from the interaction with it. Three hundred and twelve participants were randomly selected to partake in an online survey asking the emotions they might feel when exposed to XAI in an image classification scenario. Analysis shows that there are dominant emotions. Mainly, happy, confident, trusting, secure, surprised, pleased, amazed, and interested are the dominating emotions in a condition for a correct explanation. In contrast, concerned, sad, nervous, fearful, angry, dismayed, anxious, and suspicious are loaded under the wrong explanation scenario. Ultimately, the study confirms that a novel emotional set exists, potentially affecting XAI’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: An Optimal-Parent-Crossover based Differential Evolution
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Differential Evolutionary (DE) is an important part of evolutionary algorithms (EAs) and it is eﬃcient in solving complex optimization problems and has a straight- forward algorithmic structure. In order to further exploit the advantages of DE, we propose a new variant of DE called optimal-parent-crossover based differential evolution (OPCDE). Optimal-parent individuals participate in the crossover in a simple way, effectively increasing the convergence speed of the original algorithm without additional parameters. On the basis of the 30 optimization problems of the IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC) 2017 bench- mark, experimental results show that OPCDE significantly outperforms the previous algorithm and is competitive with one of the state-of-the-art DE variants, as well as outperforming two other state-of-the-art algorithms of two important branches of the meta-heuristics, GSA and PSO. At the same time, OPCDE is able to converge quickly when solving unimodal problems and always maintains a high degree of diversity when solving simple multimodal, hybrid and composition optimization problems.

articleTitle: An Improved ABC Algorithm and Its Application on Parameter Identification of Solar Cell Model
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to enhance the searching ability, an improved artificial bee colony algorithm (IABC) is proposed. In the employed bee stage, the global optimal honey source is introduced to guide the neighborhood search, the reversed learning mechanism is also introduced to increase the diversity of the population and the MR parameters is used to control the numbers of updating dimension. In the onlooker bee stage, quantum behavior is introduced to improve the convergent speed and accuracy of the algorithm. IABC is applied to solar cell model parameter identification. The experimental results show that the performance of parameter identification is improved by IABC. IABC provides a new method for solar cell parameter identification.

articleTitle: An Optimal Differential Vector Incorporated Whale Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The whale optimization algorithm (WOA) is one of the more classic optimization algorithms, which derived from the hunting actions of whale. While WOA is well suited to exploitation, this also leads to a low level of exploration capability, making it difficult to break out of the local optimum. In this study, by incorporating the optimal differential vector in an effective whale optimizer, we propose a differential perturbation operation to break out of the local optimum namely differential vector whale optimization algorithm (DVWOA). According to experimental results based on IEEE CEC2017 benchmark functions, DVWOA is beneficial in the aspects of global search, convergence speed, and population diversity.

articleTitle: Charm Factors Extraction of Sustainable Packaging Attractiveness Based on Miryoku Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the in-depth practice of "Made in China 2025", sustainable design has become a trend in the development of the packaging industry. To reduce the loss caused by excessive packaging and to increase the frequency of reuse of packaging, a more accurate understanding of consumers' preference for sustainable packaging is needed. The study investigates the link between perceptual factors of consumer psychology and sustainable packaging charm factor through the Evaluation Grid Method of Miryoku Engineering. The results of this study show that the use of Miryoku Engineering can lead to specific charm factors of consumer preference for sustainable packaging, which can provide some reference value for future designers in sustainable packaging design.

articleTitle: Research on License Plate Recognition System Based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: License plate recognition is mainly realized by image processing, pattern recognition, machine vision and other new technologies. The application of license plate recognition system plays a very important role in the convenience of people's life. At first, the paper discusses the difficult problems existing in the current license plate recognition, designs a license plate recognition system based on OpenCV, expounds the key technologies of the license plate recognition process in detail, and verifies the scheme through experiments. The experimental results show that the license plate recognition system based on OpenCV has the characteristics of high recognition accuracy and fast response speed, and is a feasible scheme.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model for Power-on Time Prediction in LF Based on Deep Neural Network and Metallurgical Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The refining cycle of ladle furnace (LF) has a critical impact on the production scheduling of the steelmaking-continuous casting section. In this work, massive industrial data was collected from a steelmaking plant and a hybrid prediction model based on Power Consumption Mechanism (PCM) and Deep Neural Network (DNN) was established for LF power-on time prediction. In the PCM-DNN model, the amount of electricity consumed in LF is first calculated by PCM, and then this value is used as one of the influencing variables to participate in the DNN training process. Finally, the comparison results show that the PCM-DNN model has higher prediction accuracy and stronger generalization performance, which can provide a useful reference for practical production.

articleTitle: Hyper-heuristic genetic algorithm for hybrid flow shop scheduling problem with unrelated parallel machines
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, a hyper-heuristic genetic algorithm (HHGA) is proposed to solve the hybrid flow shop scheduling problem (HFSP) with unrelated parallel machines. The optimization objective is to minimize the maximum completion time. To solve this problem, a hybrid flow shop scheduling problem is modeled and a hyper-heuristic genetic algorithm is presented. In this algorithm, adaptive mutation genetic algorithm is selected as the high-level strategy, and six low-level heuristic operations are designed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by comparative experiments based on different scale examples and classical algorithms.

articleTitle: A Prediction Method of Order Completion Time Based on BP-SVR
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, an order completion time prediction method based on back propagation neural network (BP) - support vector regression (BP-SVR) is proposed for multi product and multi machine shop manufacturing environment. After identifying the factors affecting the completion time, firstly, BP is applied as a feature extractor to the simulation data set containing the target features. Secondly, the extraction results are input into SVR for prediction, and finally the evaluation indicators are determined and experimentally verified. The results show that the BP-SVR model performs better in terms of goodness of fit and prediction error, and can obtain ideal prediction results.

articleTitle: Aerial Orthophoto Target Recognition and Positioning Method based on Improved YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The ground target recognition and localization method relying on UAV vision sensors can avoid carrying complex sensing equipment and reduce equipment costs. The improved deep learning YOLOX (You Only Look Once version X) target detection algorithm is proposed to be applied to the aerial photography target recognition module, and the conversion model from pixel coordinates to geodesic coordinates based on orthorectified images is constructed in the target localization module, and the input images are rotated orthorectified with the help of UAV heading angle information. Based on the fixed-wing UAV and Pytorch deep learning framework, the fast target recognition and localization of ground vehicles in aerial photography environment is simulated and realized by making aerial photography vehicle dataset, and its target recognition mAP value reaches 90%, and localization accuracy reaches less than 20 meters with real-time. The method can provide some reference for certain application scenarios that do not require high localization accuracy.

articleTitle: A Line-drawing Extraction Method for Traditional Ornament based on 3D Models
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As the entity of the cultural heritage, Chinese ancient architectures contain a large number of the traditional patterns and ornaments. In this paper, we propose an extraction method for traditional ornaments by calculating the line-drawing from 3D models of brick carvings to generate graphical pattern elements automatically. Based on the geometric attributes calculated from 3D meshes, we estimate types of feature contours that form an entire line-drawing from arbitrary views. The rendering results can be utilized in the design practice which can greatly improve the efficiency and stability of traditional ornament extraction works.

articleTitle: Factor Extraction and Glamour Evaluation of Unconscious Design
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As people's emotional demand for products gradually increases, designers pay more and more attention to unconscious design. In this context, in order to design unconsciously designed products that are more consistent with users' preferences, it is necessary to accurately understand users' preferences for unconsciously designed products. Firstly, the evaluation grid method of Miryoku Engineering is used to extract the charm elements of unconscious design products. Secondly, the charm elements of unconscious design is analyzed by questionnaire survey and quantification theory type I, so as to get the relationship between user preference and the charm elements of unconscious design.

articleTitle: Image Reconstruction Based on Multi-channel Parallel Magnetic Resonance Imaging Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the field of medical imaging diagnosis, magnetic resonance imaging technology has been widely used, but the process of imaging is time-consuming. And it is susceptible to noise and artifacts. Parallel magnetic resonance imaging technology came into being and became a widely used and researched technology. Parallel magnetic resonance imaging technique uses multiple receiving coils to collect the magnetic resonance signal simultaneously. The algorithms SENSE and GRAPPA are used in study, SENSE is a reconstruction algorithm based on image domain and GRAPPA is a reconstruction algorithm based on K space. In this paper, the two algorithms are studied and compared in detail, and the image quality of the two algorithms under different acceleration factors is evaluated by using the general image quality evaluation index. Experimental result show that in the SENSE of this paper, R=2 can obtain images with high signal-to-noise ratio and low artifact intensity. In GRAPPA, the best image is obtained at R=4 and ACS=27.

articleTitle: Intelligent Clothing Design Based on Embedded System for Blind
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Intelligent clothing is still in the preliminary development stage, and the application of embedded system gives a brand new function to the intelligent clothing. This paper first proposes the basic principles of garment design by analyzing the travel characteristics and needs of blind people in the context of great health, and then introduces the embedded system for intelligent garment design, and proposes a garment for travel needs that satisfies the pathfinding function, the fall monitoring and protection function, and the failure to get up alarm function, and confirm that this designed intelligent garment can effectively protect the travel needs of blind people.

articleTitle: Shoulder Joint Angle Measurement System Based on a Single Attitude Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The range of motion of the shoulder joint can not only evaluate the joint injury of patients but also play a guiding role in the rehabilitation of patients. In this paper, a shoulder joint angle measurement system based on a single attitude sensor is developed to evaluate the range of motion of the shoulder joint. The system includes an attitude sensor and PC software. The attitude sensor collects the Euler angle data of the upper arm and transmits the data through Bluetooth to the PC software for analysis and calculation. This paper proposes a shoulder joint angle measurement method based on a single attitude sensor. The principle of measuring the motion angle of the shoulder joint with a single attitude sensor is described in detail by establishing the corresponding mathematical model through the Euler angle. The experimental results show that the shoulder joint motion angle measurement error is ±2.5°, which can be applied to the actual measurement.

articleTitle: Design Factors Extraction of Companion Robots for the Elderly People Living Alone Based on Miryoku Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of science and technology in recent years and its application in daily use, companion robot has become a common product in the home of the elderly people live alone. In order to improve the experience of the elderly people living alone when using the companion robot, it is necessary to understand users' preferences for products more accurately. First of all, the evaluation grid method in Miryoku Engineering is used to collect users' preferences for products, and the evaluation construction diagram is developed to describe the relationship between design factors according to the results. Questionnaires were then produced to collect more broadly the influence between preferences. Finally, according to the questionnaire results, the calculation method of quantitative research is used to scientifically analyze the correlation degree between variables. The research shows that the research method of Miryoku Engineering can have a deeper understanding of users' emotional preference for products, and the research results can provide reference value for the design of care products for the elderly people living alone.

articleTitle: Research on Adoption and Diffusion of CRM from the Perspective of China
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As one important part of customer economy, CRM (Customer Relationship Management) has been widely adopted by various enterprises. By reserving win-win relationship between customers and enterprises, CRM can effectively help enterprises to increase profit margins, and to promote competitive power. To provide helpful views for researchers and business managers, in this paper we divided CRM developmental history into three stages, including embryo stage, formation stage (i.e. contact management, sales force automation and call center) and maturity stage (i.e. operational CRM, collaborative CRM and analytical CRM), and then we analyzed the stages respectively. Furthermore, we discussed on the actual applications in and outside China. We found that in China the basic knowledge of CRM still needs to be popularized, and a lot of Chinese enterprises are too sensitive to the prices of CRM products. Some helpful conclusions were provided finally.

articleTitle: Modular Integration Based on Semi public Space Body Disinfection Device
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The global novel coronavirus pneumonia has brought great impact on people's daily life, and has also strengthened the importance of health care and public health in various countries. This design is a whole body disinfection device designed for public space and semi public space. It uses ergonomics, modular design and other concepts to develop an epidemic prevention and control product that is easy to assemble, move and keep, intuitive to use and fast to run. Such epidemic prevention and control products are relatively rare in the market. This design aims to help China and even the world improve the public health and safety of public space and semi public space with large population flow and density in the post epidemic era, and to quickly assemble, emergency and carry out epidemic prevention and control in case of large-scale respiratory tract infectious diseases in the future, To avoid the spread of the virus in the dense population, to achieve early detection, early prevention.

articleTitle: An Early Warning Analysis Model of Metering Equipment Based on Federated Hybrid Expert System
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The smooth operation of metering equipment is inseparable from the monitoring and analysis of equipment alarm events by automated metering systems. With the generation of big data in power metering and the increasing demand for information security of metering systems in the power industry, how to use big data and protect data security at the same time has become a hot research field. In this paper, we propose a hybrid expert model based on federated learning to deal with the problem of alarm information analysis and identification. The hybrid expert system can divide the metering warning problem into multiple sub-problems for processing, which greatly improves the recognition and prediction accuracy. The experimental results show that our model has high accuracy in judging and identifying equipment faults.

Author Keywords: early warning of power metering equipment

articleTitle: Research on the fusion influence of participant by fusing the text sentiment feature
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to study the influence of university closure and prevent negative public opinion events, this paper crawls blog posts on the topic of "school closure" based on Weibo and analyzes their influence by fusing the sentiment of the text. The EMBUI algorithm was constructed to calculate the fusion influence. In EMBUI, participant influence is calculated based on the MBUInfluence algorithm and sentiment feature is incorporated, which are obtained by machine learning methods. The experimental results show that the fusion influence can effectively grasp the public opinion, and Logistic Regression works best in sentiment analysis. The influence of the participants is related to their own characteristics and the influence of their fans, and there is a strong correlation between their influence and the sentiment. Influence has different sentiment features, which need to be captured separately.

articleTitle: Study on Interactive and Highly Efficient 3D Reconstruction System
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As wooden cultural relics are difficult to preserve, the number and types of them gradually decrease, which makes them face the phenomenon of cultural successors. How to activate the vitality of wooden cultural heritage in today’s social background is an urgent problem. In this study, taking Nuo mask, a wooden cultural relic, as an example, an interactive multi-view 3D reconstruction system combining close-range photogrammetry technology with mobile phone camera equipment is used to optimize the efficiency of 2D image acquisition and realize efficient restoration of color, texture, geometry and material information. The experiment shows that the system effectively promotes the rapid collection and reconstruction of the data of wooden cultural relics. Meanwhile, the system has been applied and practiced in the online exhibition of the official website of Guizhou Nuo Culture Museum, which promotes the digital protection and dissemination of wooden cultural relics.

articleTitle: Reliability Data Analysis and Lifetime Prediction of Aviation Equipment Based on Logistic Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: According to the requirements of modern aviation equipment prognostic and health management (PHM), in order to promote the feasibility and practicability of reliability data analysis, this paper uses Logistic distribution to construct the reliability data analysis and lifetime prediction model of aviation equipment components, and discusses the method of determining the probability distribution type of Logistic distribution. The least square estimation method and maximum likelihood parameter estimation method of Logistic distribution are given, and the characteristics of the above two parameter estimation methods are compared. Finally, the accuracy of the method is verified by an application example in the field of aviation equipment support. We tested 20 identical components of aviation equipment. The least square estimation method and maximum likelihood estimation method are used to process the fault data respectively, and their goodness of fit are compared and analyzed. The results show that the latter has higher estimation accuracy. Therefore, the maximum likelihood estimation method is used to calculate the Logistic distribution characteristics and related reliability parameters.

articleTitle: Archive-based Differential Learning Incorporated Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is a new evolutionary algorithm that has the advantage of good exploration ability. Benefiting from its search strategy, SSA can effectively alleviate the local optima. However, it still suffers from the issue of low solution quality because of its weak exploitation ability. Therefore, we propose an archive-based differential learning incorporated sparrow search algorithm (ASSA), which introduces a local search strategy for enhancing the exploitation ability of SSA. The local search strategy searches for a superior solution in the neighborhood region of the optimal solution in each iteration and uses it to replace the original optimal solution so that SSA can find a better solution. ASSA is compared with four state-of-the-art algorithms on 29 benchmark functions of IEEE CEC2017. The experiment results demonstrate that ASSA has superior performance to its competitors.

articleTitle: Degradation tendency prediction for pumped storage unit based on CNN-LSTM model
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The degradation of pumped storage unit (PSU) affects the safe operation of pumped storage station and even the power system. Thus, it is essential to predict the degradation tendency accurately and helpful to achieve predictive maintenance as well. A combined prediction model is proposed with multi-dimensional monitoring data. Firstly, considering the effect of working head (H), active power (P) and guide vane opening (G), the healthy state model is developed based on Gaussian process regression (GPR), which can effectively describe the operating characteristic of PSU. Then, the degradation index (DI) is designed to quantify degradation degree. Further, with the ability of extracting local feature and nonlinear learning, the convolution neural network-long short-term memory network (CNN-LSTM) model is developed for degradation tendency prediction (DTP). Further, the comparative experiments are conducted with the data collected from a PSU in China. The results show that the proposed model performs better in DTP.

articleTitle: Identifying and Analyzing Interaction Design Factors for Age-friendly Products based on Sensory Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Population aging is the current China faces a big challenge, with the rapid development of information society, the elderly access to significantly enhance the probability of intelligent products, exactly in accordance with user requirements to design optimal aging interactive products, must understand the user preferences for how the product interacts for product factors and translated into concrete design features. Due to the physiological and psychological particularity of the elderly, sensory compensation and Miryoku Engineering research methods will be introduced with the aim of enhancing the user experience, exercising the senses and digging deeper into the charm factor of the research object. The method provides a certain reference for enhancing the attractiveness of product styling, interaction methods and colour schemes of age-appropriate products, as well as providing a research case for user perceptual level research.

articleTitle: A Maritime Target Identification Algorithm Based on Improved OCRNet
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved semantic segmentation method based on object contextual representations network (OCRNet) to improve the recognition ability of various objects in the complex marine environment. The proposed maritime target identification algorithm mainly improves the performance of OCRNet from two aspects. First, we introduce the channel attention module in the similar self-attention mechanism module behind the backbone network of OCRNet, allow the computer selectively value or ignore certain characteristics. Second, Focal Loss and Lovász-Softmax Loss are both adopted to improve the accuracy of algorithm recognition during training. By comparing with existing advanced semantic segmentation methods, the experimental results demonstrate that our improved method has significant advantages for semantic segmentation in marine scenes, with a recognition accuracy up to 78.65% in mIoU.

articleTitle: E-commerce Platforms Competition: A Multi-method Study of the Complexity in Competitive Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This study examines how e-commerce platforms use complex resources to win the competitive advantages in hypercompetitive context. Based on competitive interaction and configurational view, we suggest a research framework. We believe that e-commerce platforms win the competitive advantages by orchestrate the configuration of digital strategic actions the competitors hard to respond. Our study use fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis and panel data regression to analyze the news data from Chinese online tourism industry. Our findings suggest equifinal pathways to gain the effect that is hard to be responded, and these response effects can bring competitive advantage for focal e-commerce platform in competitive interaction.

articleTitle: Algorithm Comparison for the Order Grouping Problem with Delivery Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the era of digital economy 2.0, high-quality order delivery service is the key to the servitization of manufacturing. In this paper, order delivery factors are introduced into the order grouping problem. For orders with the same production process attributes, delivery factors such as delivery date, order level and transportation area are considered for order delivery commitments, and quantitative expressions for each delivery factor are defined, a method for calculating the dissimilarity degree for mixed data types is designed. Aiming at the characteristics of the problem, the applicability of three classical clustering algorithms, namely K-Means, PAM and hierarchical clustering, for solving the order grouping problem is compared and analyzed in conjunction with the order data generated based on the simulation of light industrial orders, this will help to select underlying framework for the next step of optimizing and improving the algorithm to solve order grouping problem. The results show that the structured hierarchical clustering algorithm gives better results.

articleTitle: Research on Health Education Plate Design for Elderly Based on QFD and TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The QFD-TRIZ model was introduced into the product design to address the problems of the elderly coexisting with multiple chronic diseases, poor compliance with health management and unbalanced diets. Firstly, through interviews with elderly users, the needs collected are classified from the physiological and psychological perspectives, then the HOQ tool is used to rank and classify the needs to obtain a matrix of design technology needs indicators, extract the main conflict transformation problems in the matrix into a TRIZ problem model, and use the strategies provided by TRIZ combined with knowledge of healthy diets to provide a basis for the design of health education plate design for the elderly.

articleTitle: Magnetic Properties-Based Range Image Descriptor
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the development of a new generation of information technology, range images are being used more and more in the fields of image processing, computer vision, and pattern recognition. More concretely, range images play an increasingly important role in autopilot, medical analysis, and quality inspection. As we all know, the range image is composed of a series of three-dimensional (3D) scattered points. Due to limitations of coordinate data, it makes extremely difficult to distinguish the difference between adjacent points. This paper is such an attempt to address this issue. Through the similarity analysis of electron cloud and range image, this paper presents a range image descriptor based on magnetic properties. Benefit from the classical theory of particle motion in magnetic field, Lorentz force, rotation radius, rotation period, and volume ratio parameters are calculated for each point. On that basis, a complete range image descriptor is designed to encode the potential connection of each point from a higher dimension. Experimental results show the discriminating power of the proposed method. Focusing on range image description, the simple structure of our algorithm can effectively improve the efficiency and accuracy of image processing.

articleTitle: Research on the design of emotional experience on learning live broadcast platforms in the post-epidemic context
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the current situation of learning live broadcast under the background of the post-epidemic situation, the user's emotional experience is put in the first place, and an emotional and humanized learning live broadcast APP is designed. Use the literature analysis method to summarize the research status of learning live broadcast, build a learning live broadcast platform design framework based on emotional design theory, and conduct design research, and divide user needs into appearance needs, usage needs, and emotional experience according to the instinct layer, behavior layer, and reflection layer. There are three types of needs, which turn user needs into design opportunities for design practice. The analytic hierarchy process is used to evaluate the design practice results. The results are that online self-study, quantified self, smooth operation, and information aggregation are the most important, followed by exam reminders, ease of use, image graphics, and scene rituals. Emotional and humanized care design relieves the impetuousness, anxiety and loneliness of users who are studying at home during the epidemic. The combination of emotional design and AHP theory provides reference and direction for future design research.

articleTitle: Comparison of temperature control time prediction models for wide and thick plates based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Temperature control time is a key parameter in the hot rolling process of wide and thick plate. Accurate prediction of temperature control time can help to make efficient production scheduling. The features related to temperature control time are extracted from the historical rolling data, and the classified features are converted into numerical values by using the target variable coding method. All the sample data are normalized, and the Pearson correlation coefficient between all the features is calculated to remove redundant features and features with low correlation with the target variable. Using mean absolute error, root mean square error and coefficient of determination as evaluation indicators, the accuracy and robustness of five machine learning models in predicting temperature control time are compared and analyzed. The experimental results show that the BP neural network has the best performance.

articleTitle: Multi-population genetic algorithm for seamless steel tube blank design considering delivery time
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Seamless steel tube blank design is the link between customer orders and actual production. For the customer-oriented seamless steel tube blank design problem, delivery time is a key factor as well as traditional round billet constraints and process constraints. This paper focuses on its short-round billet cutting problem to minimize the number of round blanks and the penalty of delivery time. According to the characteristics of the problem, a multi-population genetic algorithm is proposed. Encoding and decoding strategies are presented in terms of decision variable features. According to the multi-objective characteristics, it proposes a multi-population parallel evolution strategy, where the population is divided into one main population with multi-objective optimization and two auxiliary populations for each single objective, thereby enhancing the global search ability. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are verified by different scale data experiments.

articleTitle: Link Prediction on Dynamic Heterogeneous Graphs via GNN with Multiple Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Link prediction on dynamic heterogeneous graphs has attracted much attention in recent years, because it is an ideal abstract model of many problems in real application, such as the prediction of customer’s consuming behavior in electronic commerce. However, most existing link prediction methods are designed for homogeneous graphs and static heterogeneous graphs, which cannot perform well on dynamic heterogeneous graphs owing to lack of the ability of processing the dynamic information. In this paper, we propose a graph neural network (GNN) with multiple attention schemes to deal with the problem of link prediction on dynamic heterogeneous graphs. Specifically, the attention mechanism of the GNN learns the influences of the node features, the edge types and the transformation of dynamic heterogeneous graphs on link prediction. We evaluate our method on a real-world dataset which expresses the customer-commodity relations by a set of snapshots of dynamic heterogeneous graphs. Experimental result shows that our method outperforms the original method and other state-of-art baseline methods.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Multimodal Interactive Decompression Products for College Students
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As society becomes more and more competitive, everyone feels a certain amount of pressure. Among them, the psychological stress condition of college students is especially concerned. Multimodal interaction provides new ways for human-computer interaction and has good prospects for application in various fields. In this paper, we propose the design principles of multimodal interaction for stress reduction in college students through questionnaire research and interaction mode experiment. Propose interaction strategies based on Gross emotion regulation process model. It is divided into passive regulation stage and active regulation stage with corresponding interaction mode before and after the intervention of emotional expression. Finally, the design principles and strategies are used to guide the design practice to guide the college students to effectively relieve stress, reduce the probability of mental health problems in the college students.

articleTitle: Tinkling: Research on the design of a Bianqing interactive system for children based on experiential learning
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Bianqing is an ancient Chinese percussion instrument with a history of over 2,000 years. In this research, an interactive Bianqing system, “Tinkling”, was developed to give children a better understanding of the instrument and its inner cultural values. Based on projection mapping and digital sensing technology, the system takes children into the ancient Bianqing playing scene through cross interaction between physical and digital forms. The study invited 10 school-aged children and 10 of their parents to test the effectiveness of the product, and the results revealed that Tinkling increased children’s participation in the visit and motivated them to continue learning. Tinkling could bridge the distance between children and historical artefacts, which is great significance for the deeper understanding and dissemination of Chinese rituals and music.

articleTitle: Development of Sole Pressure Insole for Freestyle Aerials Skier
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Given the lack of collection means of foot pressure equipment in the whole process of freestyle aerials skiing, this paper develops a flexible force-sensitive offline pressure storage insole based on the design concept of wearable data collection. According to the biomechanical characteristics of freestyle aerials skier, ADC acquisition circuit and offline data storage circuit based on STM32F105 as the control chip is designed; biomechanical data of the plantar were collected under static standing and walking conditions to analyze the force bearing area and biomechanical characteristics of the plantar. The wearable offline pressure storage insole meets the functional requirements, provides a reliable means for the follow-up theory, and can interpret freestyle skiing aerial.

articleTitle: Intelligent Penetration and Attack Simulation System Based on Attack Chain
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Vulnerability assessment is an important process for network security. However, most commonly used vulnerability assessment methods still rely on expert experience or rule-based automated scripts, which are difficult to meet the security requirements of increasingly complex network environment. In recent years, although scientists and engineers have made great progress on artificial intelligence in both theory and practice, it is a challenging to manufacture a mature high-quality intelligent products in the field of network security, especially in penetration testing based vulnerability assessment for enterprises. Therefore, in order to realize the intelligent penetration testing, Vul.AI with its rich experience in cyber attack and defense for many years has designed and developed a set of intelligent penetration and attack simulation system Ai.Scan, which is based on attack chain, knowledge graph and related evaluation algorithms. In this paper, the realization principle, main functions and application scenarios of Ai.Scan are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Research on emotional design of weather APP interface
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Objective: To explore the emotional design requirements of the weather APP interface, so as to optimize the user’s experience, and improve the user’s attention and adaptability to weather changes. Methods: Based on the emotional design theory, combined with the emotional factor model of the mobile APP interface, conduct user interview research from the instinct layer, behavior layer and reflection layer of emotional design, and obtain the emotional design requirements of the weather APP interface. Summarize the emotional cognition problems existing in the current weather APP interface, establish design principles, carry out design output, and verify the design feasibility. Conclusion: The emotional design requirements of weather APP are obtained, and a method for emotional design of weather APP is proposed. The visual style is clear at the instinct level, the layout is reasonable, the graphics are simple and easy to identify, the function of the behavior layer is effective, and the feedback is timely. Emotional memory, improve pleasure; carry out tentative design output; not only improve the user’s visual, functional and emotional experience, promote the emotional application of interface design, but also allow more users to pay attention to weather changes from the perspective of public welfare.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Technology of Model Support System based on Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Model support system is the core system of some test equipment, and it can realize multiple degrees of freedom motion of the model. The model support system is buffeted by high-speed flow, so that it is prone to failure, the test efficiency will be greatly affected. In order to improve the operation and maintenance level of the model support system, it is necessary to realize the status monitoring of the model support system and grasp the system running status timely. This paper presents a fault diagnosis technology for model support system based on feature extraction. The vibration data of the model support system were collected. By combining kurtosis eigenvalues with fast fourier transform (FFT) analysis of peak frequencies, the fault diagnosis can be realized. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed technology were verified by real vibration monitoring data.

articleTitle: Application of Crowdsourcing to the Design of Behavior Change Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Behavior change technologies are ubiquitous. The design of behavior change technologies requires familiarity of users and exploration of proper technologies, supported by the vast information and ideas collected through crowdsourcing. This article thus applies crowdsourcing to the design of behavior change technologies. A three-week design project was conducted, whereby designers’ use of the information and ideas collected was recorded. Results validated the support of crowdsourcing, and revealed the features of crowdsourcing and traditional design methods. Designers selected higher- quality information from crowdsourcing than from traditional methods. Crowdsourcing and traditional methods collected different behavior changes, and induced different developments of behavior change technologies. Some suggestions on the application of crowdsourcing are also provided.

articleTitle: Optimization of CNN for Diagnosis on Lung Disease by Lung Segmentation and Rib Suppression
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The discrimination of lung diseases by chest X- ray images is a clinically important tool. How to use artificial intelligence to accurately and quickly help doctors to diagnose different lung diseases is very important in the context of the current COVID-19 global pandemic. In this paper, we propose a model structure, including two U-Net, which implement lung segmentation and rib suppression for chest X-ray images respectively, image enhancement techniques such as histogram equalization, which enhances images contrast, and a Xception- based CNN, which classifies the processed images finally. The model can effectively avoid the interference of regions outside the lung to CNN for feature recognition and the influence of environmental factors such as X-ray machines on the quality of X-ray images and thus on the classification. The experimental results show that the classification accuracy of the model is higher than that of the direct use of the Xception model for classification.

articleTitle: Exploratory quantitative analysis of the relationship between bamboo carving and landscape painting via SSIM
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Bamboo crafts have the attributes of sustainable development and cultural value. Considering the relationship between the theme of bamboo craft carving patterns and painting, the correlation value between craft and art is established. Through the key technology of the SSIM algorithm, the three-dimensional bamboo carving pattern is compared with the two-dimensional painting, which overcomes the screening problem of bamboo carving patterns. This study demonstrates that bamboo carving patterns imitate the themes and compositions of landscape paintings.

articleTitle: Object Marking Detection Method Based On Improved DetectoRS
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Many CNN based detectors show strong performance in detection tasks. However, for a small amount of sample data and small target detection, there are still problems such as networks are difficult to train and poor robustness. In the context of small sample brand dataset, this paper proposes a small sample brand detection model based on convolutional neural network, which integrates recursive feature pyramid and global context, aiming at the problems of sparse data samples, uneven distribution of brand size, and complex scene transformation. Finally, the Stochastic Weights Averaging is used to further improve the performance of the model and improve the generalization ability of the model. The model can finally achieve 56.2% mAP without too much computational overhead. Improve the low robustness of multi-scale detection, false detection of small targets, missed detection and other problems.

articleTitle: Study on the intelligent and innovative design of traditional graphic semantics in China
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the new era of digitalization, traditional graphics will face an enormous adaptation dilemma. Based on this situation, this paper analyzes traditional graphics from the perspective of semantics and explores a new innovative design method for intelligent graphics in conjunction with existing digital technology. We summarize the existing traditional graphic semantic expression methods (deconstruction, reconstruction and color construction), the relevant technologies for intelligent graphic design and the integration of semantics in intelligent innovative graphic design. Secondly, we take the intelligent innovative design of Chinese Hmong butterfly graphics as an example of the adaptation of innovative graphic design to the development trend of digitalization in the future. The purpose of this study is to use digital technology to interpret the process of graphic semantic expression and provide new ideas for the creative design of digital graphics.

articleTitle: Research On Innovative Elements Of Technology-Driven Product Design
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Nowadays technology drives innovative design of products. Only grasping the innovative elements that technology driven products can we create high-value innovative achievements. Based on TRIZ theory, this paper studies the feasibility of product innovation and obtaining intellectual property rights from the impact of technology application on product innovation. From the connotation of product innovation corresponding to different levels of TRIZ theory, this paper explores the impact of different forms of technology application on the function, appearance and use of products. Choosing technical principles rather than technical components for design will lead to a higher degree of novelty and creativity of new products. This paper takes the community smart pharmacy as an example of design practice to verify, so as to provide reference for the designers to reasonably apply technology in the design process and improve the product design quality.

articleTitle: Research On Crime Feature Mining Based On Extraction of Spatio-temporal Elements of Cases
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the work of public security, the temporal and spatial distribution of criminal activities is an important information. By analyzing the temporal and spatial distribution law of criminal activities, especially the relatively microscopic law, it is of great significance for police officers to solve cases, crack down on and prevent crimes. This research takes the area data under the jurisdiction of the police station as the research object, from analyzing the temporal and spatial laws of cases at the current stage to predicting the characteristics of future cases, to achieve clear and accurate identification and expression of the temporal and spatial distribution characteristics of cases, and to provide reference for decision-makers. The research content has important application and social value.

articleTitle: Study on The Wearability of Thick and Heavy Ground WeftDenim
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Objective: This paper designs a kind of weft double denim fabric with inner and outer layers, and provides guidance for the development of new denim fabric by testing its wearing performance. Methods: 1 2 samples were designed according to the whole scheme, with yarn raw materials and weft density as two change factors. Through the washing process, part of the yarn is ground and weft broken. The tensile breaking property, moisture permeability, air permeability and drapability of this part are tested. The influence of yarn type and weft density on the properties of the sample is analyzed by using fuzzy mathematics. Conclusion: when the raw material of the yarn is Tencel and cotton blended yarn and the weft density is 3 0 pieces/ cm, the tensile fracture property of the sample is better; When the yarn raw material is Tencel and artificial cotton and the weft density is 25pieces/ cm, the sample has better drapability, air permeability and moisture permeability. This paper aims to develop a new type of denim fabric, and study and analyze the change factors that can optimize the wearing performance of thick and heavy-duty yarn breaking denim fabric.

articleTitle: Multi-agent Model of AGVs Online Scheduling in Automated Sorting Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the scheduling problem of automatic sorting warehouse package and AGV, considering the uncertainty and dynamics of the real environment, an online scheduling simulation system based on multi-agent is designed. The system consists of package agent, AGV agent and management agent. The system defines the interaction mechanism between multiple agents, and at the same time embeds different scheduling strategies for the agents. Taking the minimization of the weighted total completion time as the optimization objective, simulation experiments are carried out on the scheduling strategies under different problem sizes. The results show that the urgency priority strategy has the best solution effect, indicating that the strategy has a better application in large-scale online scheduling problems.

articleTitle: Capability Evaluation on Equipment Technical Support Force
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the complexity of the equipment system has increased significantly. The requirements for equipment technical support force increased accordingly. In order to build a support force adapted to the contemporary equipment system, this paper studies the capability evaluation method of equipment technical support personnel, and constructs the capability evaluation model based on grey analytic hierarchy process. The results provide a theoretical basis for relevant enterprises to train and evaluate equipment support personnel.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of sentimental characteristics on government responses
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to study the impact of crowd mood on the government’ s response, this paper judges the relationship between emotional characteristics and government response through the actual effect of government response from different perspectives.This paper sorts out the political response theory and emotional expression theory, constructs the theoretical model of government response and puts forward the research hypothesis. Through the methods of emotion analysis and regression analysis, the data of Changzhou 12345 citizen service hotline are selected for empirical analysis. The results show that the public appeal of positive emotions is easier to be resolved by relevant government departments than negative emotions. The government should have a more comprehensive understanding of the characteristics of citizens’ actions and take corresponding measures to the emotional changes generated by citizens.

articleTitle: Combinational Indoor Layout Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: For automatic indoor furniture layout, we design a combinational optimization algorithm which takes full advantage of multi-threading using combined methods. Based on simulated annealing algorithm, four cost functions are built to optimize the layout within a single group. To avoid falling into the local minimum, the metropolis acceptance criterion is adopted to randomly jump out of the local optimal solution. Based on the design idea of indoor energy field to optimal placement point of the group, the ground energy matrix is employed. Our algorithm is proved to be able to give better layout suggestions for a variety of indoor scenes.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on the Emblem Design of Chinese and Western Universities
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Discuss the reasons and influencing factors affecting the differences between the design of Chinese and Western university emblems, provide reference for the iterative update of university emblem design, improve the accuracy and recognition of logos, accurately convey campus concepts and Chinese culture, and provide inspiration and ideas for the design of newly built or merged university emblems. Using the case analysis method and comparative analysis method, the shape and connotation of the emblem designs of 74 Western universities ranked in the top 100 QS in 2022 and 48 of China's top universities are compared and analyzed, and the differences in the expression and content of the emblems of famous universities in China and the West and the future design trends of the university emblems are summarized, and the deep background and reasons are explored. Through the comparative study of the design of the emblem of 122 universities, it is concluded that the national history and culture, ethnic regions, and campus characteristic culture are the main factors affecting the design of the logo of the university emblem, and will also be affected by the design trend.

articleTitle: The existence and exponential stability of almost automorphic solution for neutral-type high-order Hopfield neural networks with mixed delays on time scales
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the existence and exponential stability of the neutral-type high-order Hopfield neural networks with mixed delays on time scales. Firstly, we investigage the existence of the almost autmorphic solution by the Banach fixed point theorem. Secondly, based on some mathematical analysis technique, we study the global exponential stability of the almost automorphic solution. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the applicability of our proposed criteria.

articleTitle: Recognition Method of Impactor on Spacecraft Cabin Based on Acoustic Emission
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The barrel section component is the most common external structural component of large spacecraft, and it is also one of the most vulnerable parts of the spacecraft. Due to the different degrees of damage caused by different impactors, in order to formulate different maintenance plans for different damage situations and achieve autonomous health management of spacecraft, it is necessary to establish a method for identifying impactors. The characteristic parameters of the time-domain signal waveform are analyzed by using three impactors with different stiffnesses to conduct impact experiments on cylinder-like components. Aiming at the inconspicuous characteristics of the signal part parameters in identifying the impactor, this paper proposes an independent component analysis-support vector machine identification method based on particle swarm optimization. The results show that the final model classification accuracy rate is 88.2%, which can effectively identify the impactor type.

articleTitle: Density peaks clustering by granular computing with label propagation
publicationTitle: 2022 15th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Density peaks clustering (DPC) algorithm identifies the density peaks as cluster centers and forms clusters by assigning each object to its nearest higher local density neighbor. However, DPC suffers from two main issues: its local density estimation is unreliable in complex real datasets, and its cluster assignment strategy has a risk of ’chain error’. To overcome these two issues, this paper proposes a novel density peaks clustering by granular computing with label propagation. At first, each object is coarsened into the fuzzy semantic cell. The local density estimation in DPC can be interpreted from learning fuzzy semantic cells and converted into an optimization problem. We provide an alternative reliable local density estimation method. Subsequently, we allocate an initial label matrix by learned fuzzy semantic cells and then utilize the label propagation algorithm to let the label of each prototype be updated from its k nearest neighbors. The adopted label propagation method can significantly improve the cluster assignment strategy compared to DPC. To validate the proposed method, we conduct comprehensive experiments on various datasets. The results prove that our method outperforms the other state-of-art DPC-related methods.
